map_library_membership: independent development variants; excluded from the 60-map manifest and all held-out splits

scenes.variant_method: deterministic in-place object substitution; no random relocation
scenes.ray_projection_semantics: Production 2-D XY projection of every selected collision geom. Tabletops/seats conservatively block their full XY footprint; no under-furniture route is represented. This is not depth-camera or real-robot perception evidence.
scenes.collision_semantics: Static world collision primitives remain individually named by parent object and part; table/stool undersides are not filled by hidden collision volumes.

density_definition.measurement: 1 cm centre-sampled union of XY collision projections
